article_context: 文章讨论快速变化的技能需求、再培训由谁买单，以及疫情中瑞典航空把停岗乘务员短训后转去支援医院的案例。

article.title: 阅读 Text 1 · 疫情时代的再培训与技能错配
article.background: 文章讨论快速变化的技能需求、再培训由谁买单，以及疫情中瑞典航空把停岗乘务员短训后转去支援医院的案例。

sentences.en: “Reskilling” is something that sounds like a buzzword but is actually a requirement if we plan to have a future in which a lot of would-be workers do not get left behind.
sentences.zh: “再培训”听起来像一个流行词，但如果我们希望未来大量潜在劳动者不被落下，它实际上是必需的。

segments.text: “Reskilling” is something that sounds like a buzzword but is actually a requirement if we plan to have a future in which a lot of would-be workers do not get left behind.

sentences.en: We know we are moving into a period where the jobs in demand will change rapidly, as will the requirements of the jobs that remain.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，未来需求旺盛的岗位会迅速变化，保留下来的岗位对技能的要求也会随之改变。

segments.text: We know we are moving into a period where the jobs in demand will change rapidly, as will the requirements of the jobs that remain.

sentences.en: Research by the World Economic Forum finds that on average 42 per cent of the “core skills” within job roles will change by 2022.
sentences.zh: 世界经济论坛的研究发现，到2022年，各类岗位平均有42%的“核心技能”将发生变化。

segments.text: Research by the World Economic Forum finds that on average 42 per cent of the “core skills” within job roles will change by 2022.

sentences.en: That is a very short timeline.

segments.text: That is a very short timeline.

sentences.en: The question of who should pay for reskilling is a thorny one.
sentences.zh: 谁应为再培训买单，是一个棘手的问题。

segments.text: The question of who should pay for reskilling is a thorny one.

sentences.en: For individual companies, the temptation is always to let go of workers whose skills are no longer in demand and replace them with those whose skills are.
sentences.zh: 对单个企业而言，最诱人的做法往往是解雇技能不再需要的员工，再换上技能符合需求的人。

segments.text: For individual companies, the temptation is always to let go of workers whose skills are no longer in demand and replace them with those whose skills are.

sentences.en: AT&T is often given as the gold standard of a company that decided to do a massive reskilling program rather than go with a fire-and-hire strategy.
sentences.zh: AT&T常被视为典范：它选择大规模再培训，而不是采取“解雇再招聘”的策略。

segments.text: AT&T is often given as the gold standard of a company that decided to do a massive reskilling program rather than go with a fire-and-hire strategy.

sentences.en: Other companies had also pledged to create their own plans.
sentences.zh: 其他公司也承诺制定自己的计划。

segments.text: Other companies had also pledged to create their own plans.

sentences.en: When the skills mismatch is in the broader economy, though, the focus usually turns to government to handle.
sentences.zh: 不过，当技能错配发生在更广泛的经济层面时，人们通常会把解决责任转向政府。

segments.text: When the skills mismatch is in the broader economy, though, the focus usually turns to government to handle.

sentences.en: Efforts in Canada and elsewhere have been arguably languid at best, and have given us a situation where we frequently hear of employers begging for workers, even at times and in regions where unemployment is high.
sentences.zh: 加拿大等地的努力充其量只能说相当迟缓，于是我们常常听到雇主苦苦寻找工人，哪怕在失业率很高的时期和地区也是如此。

segments.text: Efforts in Canada and elsewhere have been arguably languid at best, and have given us a situation where we frequently hear of employers begging for workers, even at times and in regions where unemployment is high.

sentences.en: With the pandemic, unemployment is very high indeed.
sentences.zh: 疫情之下，失业率确实非常高。

segments.text: With the pandemic, unemployment is very high indeed.

sentences.en: In February, at 3.5 per cent and 5.5 per cent respectively, unemployment rates in Canada and the United States were at generational lows and worker shortages were everywhere.
sentences.zh: 2月时，加拿大和美国失业率分别为3.5%和5.5%，处于一代人以来的低位，各地都在缺人。

segments.text: In February, at 3.5 per cent and 5.5 per cent respectively, unemployment rates in Canada and the United States were at generational lows and worker shortages were everywhere.

sentences.en: As of May, those rates had spiked up to 13.3 per cent and 13.7 per cent, and although many worker shortages had disappeared, not all had done so.
sentences.zh: 到5月，这两个数字飙升到13.3%和13.7%；虽然许多岗位短缺消失了，但并非全部。

segments.text: As of May, those rates had spiked up to 13.3 per cent and 13.7 per cent, and although many worker shortages had disappeared, not all had done so.

sentences.en: In the medical field, to take an obvious example, the pandemic meant that there were still clear shortages of doctors, nurses and other medical personnel.
sentences.zh: 以医疗领域这个明显例子来说，疫情意味着医生、护士和其他医务人员仍然明显短缺。

segments.text: In the medical field, to take an obvious example, the pandemic meant that there were still clear shortages of doctors, nurses and other medical personnel.

sentences.en: Of course, it is not like you can take an unemployed waiter and train him to be a doctor in a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 当然，你不可能把一名失业服务员在几周内培训成医生。

segments.text: Of course, it is not like you can take an unemployed waiter and train him to be a doctor in a few weeks.

sentences.en: But even if you cannot close that gap, maybe you can close others, and doing so would be to the benefit of all concerned.
sentences.zh: 但即使填不上这个缺口，也许可以填补其他缺口，而这样做会让所有相关方受益。

segments.text: But even if you cannot close that gap, maybe you can close others, and doing so would be to the benefit of all concerned.

sentences.en: That seems to be the case in Sweden: When forced to furlough 90 per cent of their cabin staffs Scandinavian Airlines decided to start up a short retraining program that reskilled the laid-off workers to support hospital staff.
sentences.zh: 瑞典似乎就是如此：斯堪的纳维亚航空被迫暂时解雇90%的乘务人员后，启动了一项短期再培训计划，让这些停岗员工转而支援医院人员。

segments.text: That seems to be the case in Sweden: When forced to furlough 90 per cent of their cabin staffs Scandinavian Airlines decided to start up a short retraining program that reskilled the laid-off workers to support hospital staff.

sentences.en: The effort was a collective one and involved other companies as well as a Swedish university.
sentences.zh: 这项行动是集体合作的结果，既有其他企业参与，也有一所瑞典大学参与。

segments.text: The effort was a collective one and involved other companies as well as a Swedish university.
